scope.summary: Implement StudioAutoLayout (hsk.studio.auto_layout@1) as the responsive-layout contract on a frame StudioLayer that repositions children automatically as they are added/removed/resized/reordered, with flow direction vertical, horizontal, and grid (two-dimensional). Grid flow arranges children into resizable rows and columns with per-child row/column span controls (CSS-grid-style 2D layout in the same primitive as 1D stacks). Solving lives behind the LayoutEngine (MT-020); the operator auto-layout panel exposes direction + grid controls.
expected_tests: argus: auto-layout panel reachable via author_id; vertical/horizontal/grid direction
live: children reposition on add/remove/resize/reorder; grid flow packs into rows/cols with per-child span
acceptance_criteria_original: StudioAutoLayout repositions children; vertical/horizontal/grid flow with per-child span; author_id + manual entry

target_entries: Studio / Design Systems / Auto layout basics

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: [STU-DS-035] `StudioAutoLayout` (schema id `hsk.studio.auto_layout@1`) is the responsive-layout contract on a frame `StudioLayer`. A frame with auto layout repositions its children automatically as children are added, removed, resized, or reordered. The full contract below is normative and MUST be expressible on one `StudioAutoLayout` value.

[STU-DS-036] Flow direction MUST support vertical, horizontal, and grid (two-dimensional). Grid flow arranges children into resizable rows and columns with per-child row/column span controls, giving a CSS-grid-style 2D auto layout in the same primitive as one-dimensional stacks.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.
